title: Soma’s deadly ‘fate’: 355 miners killed in 13 years
content:
Another mining accident occurred last Thursday in Soma, Manisa, a district known for the Soma Kömür Işletmeleri A.Ş. disaster in which 301 mine workers lost their lives 12 years ago. Workers had warned the company management about shortcomings in occupational health and safety, yet the accident occurred despite those warnings. This is why such preventable accidents are described as work-related killings. Companies seek to keep their profit margins as high as possible by failing to carry out regular maintenance or fully implement occupational health and safety measures, while facing no meaningful sanctions for these failures. Under such conditions, workers’ health and lives effectively become another cost to be cut.


In a feature article,

Yeni Ya

ş

am

 underlined that figures covering mining accidents in Turkey since 2013 show that 70 percent of workers killed lost their lives as a result of mine collapses and crushing, poisoning or suffocation. Manisa ranked first in mining-related worker deaths, followed by Zonguldak. The largest number of deaths occurred in lignite and hard-coal mines, followed by marble, chromium and copper mines. The mining sector has expanded steadily since 2010 and is expected to grow further in the coming years, with the state preparing legal frameworks such as the so-called “Super Permit Law” to facilitate that expansion. Alongside the loss of workers’ lives, the sector has also caused ecological destruction. Workers have been killed in mines for years, while those who survive often struggle to receive their wages. Alongside the widely known struggle of Doruk Maden workers, it is estimated that more than 40 miners’ strikes have taken place since 2013.


Land grabs and ecological destruction by the mining and energy sectors


The 1.061 billion tonnes of mining waste produced annually in Turkey is physical evidence of an irreversible rupture in nature’s metabolism. This process of ecological destruction is intertwined with severe labour exploitation, while documented work-related deaths also reveal the human cost of the industry. The collapse of the heap-leach site at the Çöpler Gold Mine in İliç, Erzincan, on 13 February 2024, which killed nine workers, did not only claim the lives of those workers. Millions of cubic metres of cyanide-contaminated waste spread across the area, polluting approximately 300 decares of land. The toxic waste is believed to have reached the Euphrates River through the Çöpler Stream and from there spread into the wider river basin. This is only one example of such destruction. Hydraulic fracturing carried out for mining and oil exploration, exploratory drilling involving core sampling, and mining operations conducted without the consent or approval of local communities all contribute to deforestation. Such activities also dispossess villagers of their land, indirectly displacing rural populations and forcing them to migrate to major cities, where rapid urbanisation often pushes them into precarious employment.


The ecological destruction caused by mining operations is not confined to distant places, nor is it damage that can simply repair itself over time. Mining sectors in Turkey, Congo and similar countries operate in conditions where neither wage security nor occupational health and safety are guaranteed. The damage is not limited to cyanide and other toxic substances contaminating soil and air; it also affects mine workers’ bodies. Slow Death (Yavaş Ölüm), a documentary directed by İlkay Nişancı and presented by Aslı Odman, examines the deaths caused by thermal power plants in Elbistan over a period of 40 years, including the deadly effects of ash falling on residential areas. From this perspective, mining and other environmentally destructive activities do not cause ecological devastation only in the “outside world”; that destruction also takes place directly in the bodies of the workers whose labour sustains these industries. What miners spend during years underground extracting coal and other minerals is not only their physical strength and time, but also years of their lives. This, too, is regarded as a dimension of ecological destruction.


Soma: A graveyard for workers and a landscape of mines


The

Report on the Struggle Against Extractivism,

 prepared by the Polen Ecology Collective and published in recent months, included data for Manisa compiled by the Health and Safety Labour Observatory (ISIG) covering the period from 2013 to 2025. The data …

title: Özgür: Fund scandal is biggest fraud in Republic’s history
content:
Questions continue to surround the trillion-lira fund scandal that has shaken Turkey and left hundreds of thousands of citizens facing losses. The fact that the scandal has extended to the Justice and Development Party (AKP) ministers such as Fatma Betül Kaya, members of parliament and their family members has brought relations between the government and capital, as well as networks of economic power, under scrutiny.


The fraud unfolded in plain sight despite warnings from some economists and even direct applications to the Financial Crimes Investigation Board (MASAK) and the Capital Markets Board (SPK), including those made by former MASAK Deputy Chair Dr Ramazan Başak. The delayed investigation and failure to activate regulatory mechanisms have shifted attention beyond the companies involved to the system established by the AKP government, a government that has institutionalised fascism, suppressed the opposition through the judiciary, impoverished the public through its economic programmes, created a capitalist class from its supporters and reshaped oversight mechanisms around its own allies and policies.


The scandal has once again demonstrated the need to focus on the broader picture. Journalist Bahadır Özgür spoke to ANF about this broader picture through the fund scandal. Özgür stressed that the scandal was not a stock-market or financial crisis, but a mechanism of exploitation and wealth transfer produced by the conditions created by the government’s own economic policies. He described it as “the biggest fraud scheme in the history of the Republic, directly backed by political power and involving almost everyone within the government,” adding that fully exposing this mechanism would amount to the unravelling of the political regime itself.


How do you interpret the picture emerging from the fund scandal? Is this a financial scandal, or one of the crises arising from the relationship between the government and capital? Could it bring some of the power struggles within the government itself into the open?


First of all, this is not a financial crisis. It is a mechanism of exploitation and wealth transfer produced by the conditions created by the government’s economic policies. The foundations for fraud on this scale in the stock market were laid first by fuelling consumption through cheap credit, then by introducing the FX-protected deposit scheme to keep the exchange rate under control. As inflation surged, people were driven into the stock market in an effort to protect and increase the value of their savings.


There was a rush into the stock market, particularly after the pandemic. This was actively encouraged by the government. So to speak, companies with little more than a desk and a chair were taken public. This was accompanied by a massive media campaign, including on social media. Ultimately, the conditions for this fraud were created. There is, of course, also the issue of suspicious funds that we believe were channelled into the system through the stock market, although we do not yet know the full extent of this. That is the background to the fund scheme. Now, as to whether this was the product of a conflict within the government: a defining characteristic of this regime is that it consists not only of political parties but also of political and bureaucratic cliques and networks of interests. It is therefore less a coherent and stable structure than a contradictory one.


Another point needs to be underlined. The logic of the regime is not based on building political and economic power through institutions. It is built on families and blood ties. That is why we see family connections in almost every institution. The rent-seeking and wealth-transfer character of the economic system, combined with the contradictions within the political regime, brings tensions to the surface wherever vast amounts of wealth are at stake.


It is said that the AKP has distanced itself from some business circles it previously worked with and is now bringing different groups to the fore. What kind of economic and political realignment do you see behind this change?


I think the main reason was the government’s heavy defeat in the 2024 elections. The government realised that its propaganda apparatus was no longer working. It could no longer generate consent. The external economic and political environment had changed, and it therefore had to adapt. The networks of economic and social relations established domestically …

author: Redazione_web
title: Contro la leva militare. Lotta senza riserve
content:
Il ritorno della leva in Italia si inserisce in un quadro che vede l’incremento del numero dei militari come elemento cardine della politica di riarmo. In un contesto europeo di reintroduzione della leva (

vedi U.N. n. 16/2026

), anche l’Italia sta portando avanti un massiccio piano di rafforzamento dei contingenti militari nazionali che ha caratteristiche complesse, articolate e diffuse.


Dopo aver trascorso la primavera strizzando l’occhio al modello di reintroduzione della leva tedesco e a quello scandinavo, il ministro della difesa Crosetto ha virato verso una formula di leva camuffata che punta ad istituire un nutrito esercito di riservisti. Cerchiamo di procedere con ordine.


Nel corso dell’estate sono stati sfornati da Crosetto ben due disegni di legge.


L’8 giugno il ministro ha pubblicato uno schema di disegno di legge intitolato “Disposizioni per la costituzione di Forze di riserva in materia di personale militare nonché Delega al Governo per la revisione dello strumento militare”.


Il 4 agosto Crosetto ha depositato un ulteriore schema di disegno di legge intitolato “Disposizioni per il rafforzamento e l’adeguamento della capacità di difesa nazionale”.


Il primo DdL è quello più interessante per la questione reintroduzione della leva o provvedimenti analoghi. Si prevede sostanzialmente un poderoso incremento di reclute: 40.000 unità militari in più rispetto alle attuali, a cui va aggiunto un aumento di 2.600 carabinieri. L’incremento è da realizzare entro il 2033 ed è così scaglionato: 5.071 unità per l’anno 2028; 5.321 unità per l’anno 2029; 7.001 unità per l’anno 2030; 7.444 unità per l’anno 2031; 7.500 unità per l’anno 2032; 7.663 unità per l’anno 2033. L’andamento programmato dovrà ogni anno essere verificato in sede di legge di bilancio sulla base delle risorse disponibili.


Per realizzare l’obiettivo, oltre al rafforzamento della già attiva campagna di reclutamento (ricordiamo che dal gennaio 2026 è entrata in vigore la nuova tipologia di ferma volontaria, con retribuzione più alta e maggiori agevolazioni per i congedati che volessero accedere a impieghi nella pubblica amministrazione), viene introdotta una triplice forma di “riserva militare”.


Il disegno di legge prevede infatti la riserva operativa, la riserva specialistica e la riserva territoriale, contingenti richiamabili in qualsiasi momento. Per il periodo di addestramento periodico delle riserve (minimo 30 giorni annui) sono previste retribuzioni di 130 euro nette al giorno e un premio annuale di 1.300 euro per chi svolge tutti gli addestramenti previsti. L’addestramento è funzionale al richiamo alle armi, che potrà avvenire per qualsiasi necessità per cui il Governo ritenga di dover procedere. Inoltre, per tutta la durata del periodo effettivo di richiamo, “il datore di lavoro ha diritto a uno sgravio pari al 100% dei contributi previdenziali e assistenziali dovuti per il lavoratore assunto a tempo determinato in sostituzione del richiamato”.


La riserva operativa impiegherà, fino ai 45 anni di età, militari congedati da non più di 5 anni.


La riserva specialistica impiegherà, fino ai 55 anni di età, militari congedati che abbiano prestato servizio come ufficiali con particolari competenze professionali in campo medico, informatico, ingegneristico etc. Fin qui si tratta di militari congedati che, da “civili”, vengono richiamati alle armi e periodicamente addestrati.


La terza forma di riserva ha caratteristiche un po’ diverse. La riserva territoriale infatti impiegherà non ex congedati ma persone fino ai 35 anni che abbiano come unico requisito il diploma di scuola media inferiore (oggi insufficiente allo svolgimento di un qualsiasi lavoro nel settore pubblico, e non solo) e la partecipazione ad un periodo di ferma militare di 12 mesi.


Attenzione: considerando che la ferma volontaria annuale non c’è più, visto che è stata sostituita dalla ferma volontaria triennale (riforma in vigore dal 1° gennaio 2026), questa riserva territoriale ha un requisito – la ferma di 12 mesi – che somiglia in modo impressionante ad una leva militare. Quindi un servizio di leva introdotto come base per una riserva territoriale. Che sia il ministero a definire con propria decretazione le modalità di reclutamento, non sottoposte nemmeno all’iter istituzionale parlamentare, è assai poco rassicurante riguardo al carattere volontario del reclutamento, soprattutto se si pensa che in contesto europeo la formula di reintroduzione della leva prevede sì …

author: Unknown
title: Évènement pour un internet militant et autonome #3
content:
Suite à 2 évènements réussis le 12 septembre à la Kunda et le 27 septembre à la générale, le collectif pour un internet militant et autonome organise un troisième événement dimanche à la Kunda à partir de 16h pour rassembler, réfléchir et s'organiser vis-à-vis des technologies informatiques d'un point de vue autonome


Samedi 12 septembre, une cinquantaine de personnes se sont réunies à l'appel d'un collectif pour un internet militant et autonome. Autistici/Inventati, fournisseur de service camarade basé en Italie, venait d'annoncer sa fermeture définitive suite à sa désignation comme organisation terroriste par les États-Unis.


Les discussions fructueuses et la joie de se rassembler ont incité à réitérer l'expérience autour d'un deuxième évènement deux semaines plus tard à la Générale. Réunissant de nouveau une cinquantaine de personnes, les débats et les volontés se sont fait plus précises et ont permis de dégager plusieurs directions pour la suite :


Une volonté de transmission des savoirs techniques pour rendre les conversations plus compréhensibles, et deux axes de discussion (pour l'instant).


Nous avons donc décidé d'organiser pour la troisième fois un évènement y répondant.


Au programme :


 16h : formation technique au numérique

 17h30 : discussions


 1) S'organiser pour mettre en place des services

 2) Identifier nos besoins

 19h : cantine

 20h : projection/discussion

 23h : fin de l'évènement


Infokiosque et sérigraphie tout le long


N'hésitez pas à venir si le sujet vous intéresse, que vous soyez venu-e ou non aux évènements précédents. N'hésitez pas non plus à venir avec vos propositions

 

!


Retrouvons-nous à la Kunda, 46 Jules Lagaisse 94400 Vitry-sur-Seine, le dimanche 11 octobre à partir de 16h

author: CNT Sabadell
title: El futuro del río Ripoll
content:
El pasado 11 de noviembre, TV3 emitió el documental de investigación “Alerta inundable”, en el que cuatro técnicos de la ACA (Agencia catalana del agua) denuncian presiones de los altos cargos de la misma agencia y de algunos ayuntamientos para elaborar informes a medida de las administraciones.


Desde la manifestación multitudinaria contra la aprobación de la modificación MPG 132 hemos oído diferentes voces a favor o en contra del plan, esta modificación, permitirá, según el proyecto, la construcción de empresas en una parte del ámbito del Ripoll.


Los defensores de la modificación nos dicen que se instalarán empresas ecológicamente limpias, como gimnasios, restaurantes o comercios que quizás contaminan poco por su actividad, pero que, para hacerlos en el Ripoll, necesitarán construir rotondas y accesos para los coches, el mismo estudio estima desde 38000 hasta las 7000 se instalen.


Hace poco, hemos visto cómo

los terrenos adquiridos por el CE Sabadell para hacer la ciudad deportiva han quedado inundados por el último temporal

.


Desde nuestro sindicato, hemos aportado nuestro grano de arena dentro de la Plataforma en Defensa del Ripoll, hemos trabajado para denunciar los intereses que hay detrás de esta aprobación, en este contexto, hemos señalado el papel del Gremio de Fabricantes y la finalidad que habría detrás del proyecto: dar salida y recalificar unos terrenos que actualmente tienen poco valor porque no es posible desarrollarlos.


Hay que decir que también hemos encontrado gente que afirma que no pueden aprobar este plan si es tan nocivo para la ciudad, que hay garantías, pues bueno, ¿quién se encarga de velar por los intereses del Ripoll?


En teoría, existe una autoridad protege los intereses de las cuencas de los ríos, este organismo es la Agencia Catalana del Agua (ACA), esta agencia pública ha hecho un informe que da luz verde al plan.


En este informe, la ACA no tiene en cuenta el nuevo contexto climático actual. Es decir, a la hora de valorar los riesgos, no incorpora los nuevos factores derivados del cambio climático, como los episodios extremos que han provocado la DANA en Valencia o las riadas de Alcanar.


Sólo este hecho ya debería ser suficiente para detener la modificación MPG132, ya que estamos ante un contexto climático que ha cambiado y que no puede ignorarse a la hora de planificar y autorizar nuevas construcciones.


Pero, por si esto fuera poco, a finales del año pasado, TV3 emitió el documental de investigación “Alerta inundable”, en el que cuatro técnicos de la ACA denuncian presiones de los altos cargos de la misma agencia y de algunos ayuntamientos para elaborar informes a medida de las administraciones.


Ante estas denuncias, no podemos dejar de preguntarnos si el informe de la ACA sobre el MPG132 puede responder también a este tipo de presiones. No lo sabemos, y no nos atrevemos a afirmarlo, pero consideramos que es una cuestión lo suficientemente grave como para que se haga pública, se aclare y se pueda garantizar que el informe se ha elaborado con total independencia y rigor.


Cabe decir que la ACA nos cuesta entre impuestos de canon del agua que pagamos y subvenciones, entre 500 y 700 millones de euros anuales.


Pues bien, la Agencia Catalana del agua es quien vela por que en los ríos no se edifique, aunque con la información anterior ya habría motivo de abrir investigación de antifraude.


Aquí podría continuar con un escrito sobre el abandono que sufrimos y sufriremos los y las ciudadanas por parte de las administraciones, y lo importante que es la autoorganización, pero no es el caso que me lleva a escribir esta carta.


Dicho todo esto, cualquier persona que no tuviera un interés directo en esta modificación diría que se detuviera el Plan, pero igualmente queremos exponer tres argumentos por los que consideramos que este proyecto debería retirarse, incluso sin tener en cuenta lo que he expresado anteriormente.


Lo primero es la falta de necesidad del plan MPG132.


No tiene sentido impulsar actividad industrial en terrenos vinculados a la cama y alrededor de un río, con toda la infraestructura vial que ello conlleva, cuando en Sabadell tenemos polígonos industriales con zonas prácticamente abandonadas.


Y aquí hay que decir otra cosa: muchos de estos polígonos no disponen ni siquiera de un adecuado acceso en transporte público a primera hora de la mañana. Esto obliga a muchos trabajadores y trabajadoras a desplazarnos en coche, motocicleta o patinete hasta …

author: CNT Sevilla
title: Colonos
content:
Sí hombre, pregunto si sois colonos sionistas…


Estoy parado en la carretera de Sevilla a la Algaba, a unos 13km de la ciudad. Parado en mitad de una carretera comarcal echado a un lado en el poco arcén que tiene el camino. Sostengo en la mano mi café de las 02:00, aunque son poco más que las 23:00. Me siento intranquilo por la conversación, aunque mi corazón me dice que hice bien en mantener mi postura.


Hace menos de media hora, conducía por las calles céntricas de Sevilla. Sin mucha prisa. Me saltó un viaje en la app para recoger al lado de la catedral a un tal Steven. Era una pareja de unos veintimuchos con apariencia de turistas, educadamente me saludaron en un inglés muy sonoro y continuaron su conversación.


No suelo prestar atención a lo que hablan de fondo las personas que llevo de un lugar a otro, pero cuando hablan sobre nuestros monumentos, pues me gusta tratar de oír la opinión que guardan y hacerme una idea de cómo se ve nuestra ciudad desde fuera. Hablaban de que no era demasiado guay y que le faltaban detalles distinguidos más coloridos (es su opinión y todos tenemos derecho a ser unos cutres o soberbios, qué te digo…), incluso se quejaban de que aparentaba no ser muy antigua (macho Steven, el equipo de restauración hizo un trabajo inconmensurable después de limpiar toda la polución… Al menos eso le debemos de respeto a su curro, en fin.).


Sin embargo lo que me hizo erizar las orejas fue el comentario sobre la Giralda. “No entiendo por qué no terminaron el trabajo y se deshicieron de todo lo musulmán cuando derribaron la mezquita. Es un error que no cometemos en casa. Aún le faltan agallas a España.”


¿Es turismo de placer o tratáis de asentaros en algún pueblo para montar vuestra siguiente colonia?


Recuerdo pensar que le entendí mal. -El acento- me dije -No es el contenido, es que no les he pillado bien las palabras. Después de unas risas cómplices entre ellos, sí llegué a entender una frase que me quitó las inseguridades: “… Si al final se trata de que hay tierras sin personas para personas sin tierra, se trata de asentarte y trabajar sobre ella para hacerla tuya.”


Frené de inmediato. En el inglés mejor pronunciado que sé inicié la conversación:


-Disculpad, por casualidad habláis de la frase “un pueblo sin tierra para una tierra sin pueblo”?


+ ¡Oh, hablas inglés! Qué raro en este país. Pues sí, hablamos de esa frase. ¿La habías oído antes?


– (sonreí) Sí, sí que la había oído. Me surgen una cuestión, ¿por casualidad sois de Israel?


+¡Anda, pues sí! De Tel-Aviv. Nacimos allí y estamos haciendo turismo por Europa.


-Andaaa, qué bien. Y ¿es turismo de placer o tratáis de asentaros en algún pueblo para montar vuestra siguiente colonia? (se les borró la sonrisa).


+¿Cómo?


-Sí hombre, pregunto si sois colonos sionistas.


+No, somos ciudadanos israelíes. No entiendo esta actitud discriminatoria y antisemita por parte de un trabajador de tu empresa.


-En este coche mientras yo esté al volante no entran colonizadores ni nazis. Y menos, la mezcla de ambos. Bajaos ahora mismo del coche.


No entraré en detalles sobre los insultos, gritos y llantos haciéndose la víctima de ambos colonos israelíes, porque no acabaríamos este artículo ni al florecer de los naranjos, pero lo último que conseguí que oyeran de mi boca, mientras los dejaba en una parada de autobús de línea en la carretera de la Algaba (aún desde aquí con mi café puedo ver sus siluetas en la lejanía) fue un “Palestina es el nombre de vuestra tierra, aunque queráis borrarla como lo intentaron con nuestra mezquita. Que disfrutéis esperando al autobús. Pasará mañana sobre las 06:00”.


Al colonialismo y al fascismo: ni aire para que respiren.


Discuto mucho en mi familia sobre este tema. Suelo reducirlo a que

Israel no existe

, que son una colonia, que no existe algo como la “solución de los dos estados”, que no existe la “etnia” judía (eso, de hecho, es antisemitismo en estado puro), que el sionismo judío y el católico son un cáncer y debería dejar de existir, y el ya consabido por todos argumento de “no te comportes como un nazi, por favor”.


Intuyo que este artículo nacido de mis sesgos se aparta de mi actitud socrática de “hacer pensar al interlocutor sobre si hace o no bien para que reflexionemos juntos” que suelo llevar cuando me leéis. Pero recordad mis amados lectores. Al colonialismo y al fascismo: ni aire para que respiren.

Colonos

 apareció primero en

CNT Sevilla

.

author: CNT Guadalajara
title: Crónica de la concentración en defensa de las condiciones laborales de lxs bomberxs forestales y nuestro patrimonio natural
content:
El pasado viernes 2 de octubre los compañeros de la sección sindical de CNT en Geacam volvimos a salir a la calle junto al resto de organizaciones sindicales, acompañados por representantes de los ayuntamientos de los pueblos afectados por el incendio de la Mierla, colectivos sociales de Guadalajara, así como por trabajadorxs de Geacam y arropados por compañeros de nuestro sindicato y gente de la provincia. Hubo también algún medio de prensa que se acercó para informar de la situación.


Aunque reunimos a unos cuantos cientos de personas, si que echamos en falta la presencia de más compañerxs del dispositivo y gente de los pueblos. Aun así, conseguimos hacer el suficiente ruido para que se nos escuchara y denunciamos las carencias del dispositivo, la precariedad instaurada en esta empresa y pusimos de evidencia la nefasta gestión del incendio de la Mierla, el peor de la historia en nuestra comunidad.


Se leyó el comunicado de las organizaciones convocantes, se corearon consignas en defensa de nuestro colectivo y de nuestro patrimonio, y se dejo el micro abierto para que tanto trabajadorxs del dispositivo, ayuntamientos y gentes de los pueblos afectados y el resto de organizaciones participantes pudieran tomar la palabra.


Por último, se informó de la marcha que un grupo de trabajadorxs del dispositivo están organizando por la zona del incendio como señal de protesta por todo lo ocurrido.


Fue una jornada de protesta cargada de reivindicaciones y donde exigimos también la dimisión de los máximos responsables de nuestra pobre situación laboral y de la mala actuación durante el incendio de la Mierla.


Queremos agradecer el apoyo y agradecimiento de todas aquellas personas que se acercaron a la concentración y reiteramos nuestro compromiso en la defensa de los derechos laborales de lxs bomberxs forestales y de nuestros pueblos y montes.


¡Que viva la lucha de lxs trabajadorxs!

author: Thiago Domenici
title: Processo da Advocacia da União contra bets tem 14 empresas que passaram impunes por CPI
content:
Em junho de 2025, a CPI das Bets terminou em pizza – como se diz quando uma investigação acaba sem punir ninguém. Mas agora, mais de um ano depois, as empresas que passaram impunes pela comissão estão de volta, desta vez como alvos de uma ação civil pública na Justiça.


No dia 28 de setembro, a Advocacia-Geral da União (AGU)

entrou

 na Justiça Federal em Pernambuco contra 17 empresas ligadas a 20 marcas de apostas online, pedindo ressarcimento de gastos pela União.

A

Agência Pública

 cruzou essa lista com a documentação reunida pelos senadores da CPI e descobriu que ao menos 14 delas estavam nos documentos da comissão como remetentes ou beneficiárias de transferências financeiras. Dessas, 12 foram citadas no relatório final.

 Esse documento, da então senadora Soraya Thronicke (Podemos-MS) – que não foi reeleita neste ano -, foi rejeitado por 4 votos a 3.


Na ação da AGU, o órgão pede que as empresas de apostas ressarcem o Sistema Único de Saúde (SUS) pelo tratamento de apostadores adoecidos, custo que o Ministério da Saúde (MS) estima em, no mínimo, R$ 2,6 bilhões. Pede também R$ 1 bilhão por danos morais coletivos e a devolução em dobro do que as pessoas diagnosticadas com ludopatia apostaram.


Aparecer nos papéis da CPI não indica, por si só, irregularidade. Nem todas as empresas aparecem como suspeitas. A Superbet, por exemplo, surge como titular legítima de uma autorização que outra plataforma teria usado indevidamente. Duas, a OIG e a Ventmear (Sportingbet), estão ligadas a pedidos de indiciamento, todos contra pessoas, não contra as empresas. Seis delas, OIG, Esportes Gaming, NSX, Ventmear, BPX e Foggo (Blaze), somam cerca de 31% do mercado, segundo as contas da própria AGU, e ocupam lugar de destaque nas 541 páginas deixadas por Thronicke.


Muitas siglas: Bets, CPI, MP de Lula e Fux no STF


A ação da AGU veio três dias depois da

Medida Provisória 1.394

, assinada pelo presidente Lula, que

proíbe

 as apostas de quota fixa, tira as plataformas do ar até 6 de outubro e extingue as autorizações em 30 dias, sem devolver o que as empresas pagaram pelas outorgas.

Se o Congresso não aprovar a MP em até 120 dias de tramitação, prazo suspenso durante o recesso parlamentar, ela perde a validade.

 A CPI já havia ido nessa direção: entre as vinte medidas do relatório derrubado estava a proibição de cassinos on-line, como o Tigrinho.


A Associação Nacional de Jogos e Loterias (ANJL) e o Instituto Brasileiro de Jogo Responsável (IBJR) já apresentaram pedido a Luiz Fux, do Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF), para suspensão dos efeitos da medida provisória.


Nesta segunda-feira, 5 de outubro, a AGU pediu que o STF rejeite a suspensão da Medida Provisória. Na manifestação, assinada pelo advogado-geral Jorge Messias, a AGU sustenta que o marco legal das bets, formado pelas leis 13.756/2018 e 14.790/2023, era “extensamente falho” e falhava em autorização, fiscalização, publicidade e prevenção à lavagem de dinheiro. Para concluir, a peça diz que “o ‘dragão’ era indomável”. O órgão cita dados oficiais segundo os quais os registros no SUS ligados ao jogo patológico cresceram 140% entre 2018 e 2025, e as apostas retiraram R$ 62,5 bilhões dos orçamentos familiares só em 2025. A AGU também pediu que o procurador-geral da República seja ouvido em 72 horas e sugeriu uma nova audiência pública sobre o tema, atualizando a realizada em novembro de 2024.


Como a CPI terminou em pizza


Em 26 de novembro de 2024, Fernando Oliveira Lima, o Fernandim OIG, sentou-se diante dos senadores da CPI das Bets amparado por um habeas corpus. Tinha 33 anos, disse ter estudado até o primeiro ano do ensino médio e se apresentou como empresário de tecnologia, criador de jogos para o Facebook que teriam alcançado 250 milhões de usuários durante a pandemia. Os senadores exibiram dois vídeos e perguntaram se ele conhecia os sites 7Games, R7Games e Betão. Ele conhecia e disse que pertenciam à OIG Gaming Brazil, da qual é sócio. Perguntaram se era dono do “jogo do tigrinho”, mas ele negou. Respondeu que a OIG pagava para oferecê-lo. O empresário contou ainda que, naquela mesma semana, a empresa havia sido uma das primeiras a obter a aprovação completa do Ministério da Fazenda para operar.


A CPI das bets a fez audiência com depoimentos de três representantes de casas de apostas, entre eles Fernando Oliveira Lima, CEO da OIG Group


Fernando não era o único convocado do dia. A pauta listava também João Studart, dono da Betnacional, e Marcus …

author: Unknown
title: 37. Ankara Film Festivali’nin Ulusal Uzun Film Yarışması jürisi açıklandı
content:
Dünya Kitle İletişimi Araştırma Vakfı tarafından 12-20 Kasım tarihlerinde düzenlenecek 37. Ankara Film Festivali’nin Ulusal Uzun Film Yarışması jürisi açıklandı. Jüriye yönetmen, senarist ve yapımcı Semih Kaplanoğlu başkanlık edecek.

Jüride Kaplanoğlu’nun yanı sıra oyuncu Şenay Gürler, yönetmen ve senarist Gözde Kural, sanat yönetmeni ve yapım tasarımcısı Meral Aktan ile görüntü yönetmeni Özgür Eken yer alacak.

Yönetmenliğini yaptığı “Bal” ile 2010’da Berlin Film Festivali’nde Altın Ayı En İyi Film Ödülü’nü kazanan Semih Kaplanoğlu, “Herkes Kendi Evinde”, “Meleğin Düşüşü”, “Yumurta”, “Süt”, “Buğday”, “Bağlılık Aslı” ve “Bağlılık Hasan” filmleriyle tanınıyor.

Kaplanoğlu, “Buğday” ile Tokyo Film Festivali’nde En İyi Film Ödülü’nü, “Bağlılık Aslı” ile Boğaziçi Film Festivali’nde En İyi Yönetmen Ödülü’nü aldı. “Bağlılık Hasan” ise 2021’de Cannes Film Festivali’nin Un Certain Regard bölümünde gösterildi.

Kaplanoğlu sinemanın yanı sıra tiyatroda da yönetmenlik yaptı. İstanbul Devlet Tiyatroları’nda “Limon” ve “Kuşdili” oyunlarını sahneye koydu.

Oyuncu Şenay Gürler, jürinin bir diğer üyesi olacak. Gürler, “Korkuyorum Anne” ile SİYAD En İyi Yardımcı Kadın Oyuncu, “Kasap Havası” ile Sadri Alışık En İyi Kadın Oyuncu ödüllerini kazandı. Sinema çalışmalarının yanı sıra tiyatro ve televizyon yapımlarında da rol alan Gürler, “Avrupa Yakası”, “Kaçak Gelinler” ve “Şahsiyet” gibi dizilerde yer aldı.

Yönetmen ve senarist Gözde Kural da jüride bulunacak. İlk uzun metrajı “Toz”u 2015’te çeken Kural’ın ikinci uzun metraj filmi “Cinema Jazireh”, 2025’te Karlovy Vary Uluslararası Film Festivali’nde dünya prömiyerini yaptı ve Ekümenik Jüri Ödülü kazandı.

Sanat yönetmeni ve yapım tasarımcısı Meral Aktan ise “Ahlat Ağacı”, “Bağlılık Hasan”, “Kuru Otlar Üstüne”, “Tereddüt Çizgisi” ve “Gülizar” gibi filmlerde görev aldı. Aktan, SİYAD ve Antalya Altın Portakal Film Festivali’nde sanat yönetimi dalında ödüllendirildi.

Jürinin son üyesi görüntü yönetmeni Özgür Eken olacak. Eken, “Yumurta”, “Süt”, “Gözetleme Kulesi” ve “Bağlılık Hasan” gibi filmlerdeki çalışmalarıyla Adana, Antalya, İstanbul ve Boğaziçi film festivallerinde En İyi Görüntü Yönetmeni ödüllerine layık görüldü.

37. Ankara Film Festivali 12-20 Kasım tarihleri arasında Ankara’da gerçekleştirilecek. Ulusal Uzun Film Yarışması’nın kazananları, 20 Kasım Cuma akşamı düzenlenecek Kapanış ve Ödül Töreni’nde açıklanacak.

author: Unknown
title: Filistinli siviller tali hasar mıdır?
content:
Atina’da halen sürmekte olan beynelmilel film festivalinde NAZA belgeselinin 1 Ekim’deki iki gösterimi de kapalı gişe gerçekleşti. Bu sene komşunun başkentinde 32. kez tertip edilen sinema buluşması öncesi, Yunanistan ile İsrail’in son zamanlardaki yakın ilişkisi yüzünden belgesel gösteriminin iptal edilme ihtimallerinden bile bahsediliyordu. Lakin, Venedik’te bomba etkisi yapan prömiyerinden sonra meselenin dünya gündemine tekrar yerleşmesine yarayan film fiyakalı etkinlikte gösterilmekle kalmadı, ertesi gün Atina ve Selanik sinemalarında vizyona girdi.


Belgeselin festival gişesinde nail olduğu başarıdan ve başkentin sokaklarında sık sık rastladığım Filistin’e destek grafitilerin yüksek sayısından dolayı, fazlasıyla kalabalık olacağına inandığım ilk halk gösterimine vakitlice yetişmem şarttı!


Lakin daha önce gitmediğim, başkentin merkezinden nispeten uzak ve bana sapa gelen bir semtindeki sinema salonuna bu durumda taksiyle gitmem beklenirken, Atina’da yaşanmakta olan “taxi” dehşeti yüzünden otobüsleri tercih etme gafletinde bulundum. Filmin başlamasına kısa bir süre kala kilometrelerce mesafeyi hızla yürüyerek katetmek, artık sadece cep telefonu marifetiyle rezervasyon alıp sıradan müşterilerini snobe eden şoförlerle muhatap olmaktan gene de iyiydi (Kaldırımlarda slalom yaparak yürümeme sebep olan köpek dışkılarının bolluğu da cabası!).


Fakat son anda yetiştiğim ilk gösterim için bırak gişenin önünde bulmaktan korktuğum hengâmeyi, işbu yazının da bir parçası olduğu, Filistin’e yönelik entelektüel pornografinin bazıları için festival ve sinema fetişizmiyle özdeşleştiğini hissettim; ne de olsa heyula gibi sinema salonunda yirmi kişi ha var, ha yoktuk! Hatta İngilizce altyazı olmadığını fark eden bir baba ve oğul etrafa asgari rahatsızlık vererek ortamı hızla terk ediverdi.


Cellat daima ortalıkta


2026 Birleşik Krallık yapımı 80 dakikalık ödüllü

NAZA

’nın prodüktörleri arasında The Guardian olunca insan belgesele daha da güvenerek yaklaşıyor. Üstelik filmin yönetmen ve senaryo yazarları bir o kadar çarpıcı

Gidecek yer yok

 belgeseline imza atanlardan İsrailli muhalifler

Yuval Abraham

ve

 Rachel Szor

.


Lakin aralarında, Filistinlilere yönelik soykırım yapılmakta olduğunu kabul edeni dahil 24 asker ve istihbarat memurunun filmde ziyadesiyle gerçekçi ve inandırıcı itiraflarına rağmen İsrail devleti ve 

Netanyahu

 belgeseli tabii ki lanetlemekle meşgul. Filmi gerçekleştiren ekibe yönelik tehditler gırla gittiği gibi İsrail vatandaşlığından çıkarılma ihtimalleri de Kültür ve Spor Bakanı

Miki Zohar

tarafından kurcalanıyor.


Sözde ateşkese rağmen İsrail’in asla durdurmadığı Filistin’e yönelik ölümcül saldırılar dünya gündeminde her geçen gün daha az yer kaplarken umuyoruz ki NAZA belgeseli meselenin fail devlet halkı tarafından da sorgulanmasına yol açsın.


Ne de olsa bir ritüel gibi her akşam saat sekizde Channel 12 televizyon kanalının karşısına geçen sıradan vatandaşlar fazlasıyla taraflı ve sansürlü haberlere maruz kaldıkları için vaziyetin vahimliğinden de bihaber olabiliyorlar. Kasvetin ve sessizliğinin çökmüş olduğu, ışıltılı gökdelenlerle “süslü” Tel Aviv gecelerini biz ışıklandırılmamış çatılarda itiraflarda bulunan askerlerle geçiriyoruz. Kamera birer silüet şeklindeki itirafçıları bizden nispeten saklıyor; lakin etraftaki evlerde huzur içinde yaşayan insanları gündelik hayatlarını idame ettirirken uzaktan da olsa izleyebiliyoruz. Zaten her şey İsrail halkının korkmadan, konfor içinde yaşamını sürdürmesi için yapılmıyor mu?


Kamera sık sık, yaptığı kötülükler suratından okunan Netanyahu’nun muhtelif yuvalardaki televizyon görüntülerine odaklanıyor. Hakikatleri örtmek veya çarpıtmak üzere propaganda konuşmaları inatçı liderin çeşitli suçlardan hapse girmemek için uydurduğu gündem ve senaryolara çok uygun!


Bilmediğimiz malumata ulaşabiliyor muyuz?


Aslında monoton bir anlatım şekli seçmiş olan belgeselin yaratıcıları söylenenlere daha iyi konsantre olmamıza bu şekilde imkân tanıyor. Yapay zekâ marifeti  ve cep telefonları takip edilmek suretiyle İsrail tarafından öldürülen Filistinlilerin sayısının her gün nasıl arttığına vâkıf oluyoruz. Bilhassa gece eve döndükleri zaman sistem, potansiyel Hamas üyesi olarak damgaladıklarını yok etmeye daha meyilli. Ne de olsa “Baba nerede?” kodu, cep telefonları takip altında tutulan çocuklar aracılığıyla ulaşılan bilgiyi betimliyor ve gece herkes uykuya daldıktan sonra ev, tüm aile fertleriyle havaya uçuruluyor. Genelde yapay zekâ kararının insan …

title: Li dijî Şaredariya Esenyurtê operasyon pêk hat: 17 kes hatin desteserkirin
content:
Di lêpirsîna bertîl û gendeliya îhaleyan ya li dijî Şaredariya Esenyurtê de ji bo 19 kesan biryara desteserkirinê hat derxistin. Ji bo Şaredariya Esenyûrtê di sala 2024an de qeyûm hatibû wezîfedarkirin û ji wê rojê qeyûm birêve dibe.


Di çarçoveya lêpirsîna ku ji aliyê Serdozgeriya Komarê ya Stenbolê ve tê meşandin de hat îdîakirin ku di hinek îhaleyên şaredariyê de gendeltî hatiye kirin û di vê çarçoveyê de ji karsazan bertîl hatiye girtin. Ji 19 kesên ku biryara desteserkirinê ji bo wan hatibû derxistin, jê 17 kes di operasyonê de hatin desteserkirin.


Ji bo Şaredariya Esenyurtê qeyûm hat wezîfedarkirin


31 Cotmeh 2024


Pêvajoya tayînkirina qeyûm


Serokê Şaredariya Esenyurtê Ahmet Ozer, di hilbijartinên herêmî yên 31ê Adara 2024an de namzetê CHPê bû û piraniya dengan bi dest xist û bû Şaredarê Esenyûrtê.


Di 30ê Cotmeha 2024an de Serokê Şaredariya Esenyûrta Stenbolê Ahmet Ozerê ku ji CHPê hat hilbijartin di serdegirtina mala xwe de hatibû desteserkirin.


Şaredarê Esenyurtê Ahmet Ozer hat girtin


31 Cotmeh 2024


Her weha Ozer di 31ê Cotmehê de jî bi tohmeta ku "endamê rêxistina terorê ye" hatibû girtin.


Wezareta Navxweyî heman rojê Alîkarê Waliyê Stenbolê Can Aksoy wek qeyûm ji bo Şaredariya Esenyurtê erkdar kiribû.


Wezaretê di daxuyaniya xwe ya têkildarî tayînkirina qeyûm de weha gotibû:


“Şaredarê Esenyurtê Ahmet OZERê ku di çarçoveya lêpirsîna bi hejmara 2024/162302 ya Serdozgeriya Komarî ya Stenbolê de ji aliyê dadgehê ve bi tohmeta ku 'Endamê Rêxistina Terorê ya Çekdar PKK/KCKê ye' hat girtin. Li gorî xala 127an a Destûra Bingehîn û xala 47an a Qanûna Şaredariyê ya bi hejmara 5393an, ji aliyê Wezareta Karên Navxweyî ve weke tedbîreke demkî ji wezîfeyê hat dûrxistin.”


“Li gorî xalên 45 û 46an ên Qanûna Şaredariyê ya bi hejmara 5393an Alîkarê Waliyê Stenbolê Can AKSOY ji aliyê Walîtiya Stenbolê ve weke qeyûm ji bo Şaredariya Esenyurtê hat tayînkirin.”

title: Rusya'dan Ukrayna'ya kapsamlı saldırı: Askeri sanayi tesisleri hedef alındı
content:
Rusya Savunma Bakanlığı, Ukrayna’ya gece saatlerinde kara, deniz ve havadan fırlatılan yüksek hassasiyetli silahlar ile insansız hava araçları kullanılarak kapsamlı saldırı düzenlendiğini açıkladı.

Bakanlığın açıklamasına göre saldırıların hedefinde, Ukrayna’nın savunma sanayisine yönelik üretim faaliyetleri yürütülen tesisler yer aldı.

Rusya Savunma Bakanlığı, saldırılarda özellikle “Flamingo” seyir füzeleri ile uzun ve orta menzilli İHA’ların üretimi ve depolanmasında kullanılan tesislerin hedef alındığını öne sürdü.

Açıklamada söz konusu tesislerin, Ukrayna merkezli Fire Point şirketinin faaliyetleri kapsamında kullanıldığı belirtildi.

Kiev ve Kiev bölgesinin yanı sıra Çernigiv, Kirovograd, Dnipropetrovsk, Poltava ve Harkiv bölgelerindeki askeri sanayi tesislerinin de saldırıların hedefi olduğu kaydedildi.

Rusya Savunma Bakanlığı, Odessa bölgesindeki liman ve gemi onarım altyapısının da saldırılarda hedef alındığını bildirdi.

Açıklamada ayrıca Ukrayna ordusunun çıkarları doğrultusunda kullanılan bazı deniz araçlarının vurulduğu ileri sürüldü.

Rusya Savunma Bakanlığı’nın ikinci açıklamasında ise Rus hava savunma sistemlerinin gece boyunca ülkenin farklı bölgelerinde 311 Ukrayna İHA’sını imha ettiği iddia edildi.

Rus makamları tarafından paylaşılan bu bilgilere ilişkin Ukrayna tarafından yapılmış bağımsız bir doğrulama ya da saldırıların yol açtığı hasara ilişkin ayrıntılı bilgi ise açıklamada yer almadı.

Venez passer la journée avec nous pour discuter de féminisme et de révolution, découvrir l'histoire du collectif et construire des perspectives, et aussi faire la fête

 

!

 et organisatrice de soirées pendant des années, Ana Bleue a joué dans les bars et clubs de la capitale.

DJ

Fan de basses, de musiques boom boom, de rythmes qui font onduler le bassin. Les sets de

 pasión agresión naviguent en ondes sonores troubles et agitées : du

UK

 garage à l'acid house – le tout relevé par une pointe de disco et de fantaisie. Un groove irrésistible pour entamer la "revolución" sur le dancefloor.


Toute la journée : exposition des archives du collectif


Nous sommes un collectif féministe né en 2016 des mobilisations contre la loi Travail. Nous défendons un féminisme révolutionnaire anticapitaliste, antiraciste, antifasciste, pro droits des personnes trans, respectueux des droits de travailleur·euses du sexe et radicalement solidaires des peuples opprimés.


Nous organisons des moments d'échange et de formation, nous participons à de nombreuses manifestations et nous soutenons toutes les luttes des travailleurs et travailleuses, et plus largement celles qui participent à construire une société plus juste. Par la grève féministe, nous pensons qu'il est possible d'arracher de nouveaux droits et se rapprocher de notre horizon : le renversement complet du système pour des vies dignes, libres, sans exploitation ni violences.

title: Assemblée anti-électorale
content:
Pour ne plus jamais culpabiliser de ne pas participer à un front républicain


RDV

 Dimanche 11 Octobre - Arènes de Lutèce - 14h30


«

 

Des gens sont morts pour que tu...

 

»

TA


GUEULE

 

!


Et toi tu votes

 

?


Les rapaces de la politique posent cette question comme une ritournelle, alléchés par les promesses de la foire électorale et son odeur de carcasse réchauffée au micro-onde. Au nom de milliards de raisons bancales régurgitées depuis le début des institutions républicaines, ces oiseaux de malheur en ont soudainement après votre carte électorale. On s'en fout car cela fait longtemps qu'on est nombreux à n'avoir aucune envie de se mêler d'une quelconque manière au jeu électoral. Cependant, ça commence à nous taper sur les nerfs cette nuée de mouches à merde qui viennent vendre leur soupe parlementaire au beau milieu d'espaces politiques radicaux et révolutionnaires. On ne laissera pas leurs larves nous manger le cerveau plus longtemps par ce chantage moral et ce pragmatisme instrumentalisant qui voudrait que ne pas voter équivale à tuer des personnes marginalisées ou à se rendre coupable des pires exactions dont l'État est capable. Notre refus de l'appel à voter n'est pas un appel à l'abstention

 

; pas question d'ajouter de la passivité à la résignation ambiante. Ce qui nous intéresse c'est moins de ne pas voter que de lutter contre ceux qui appellent aux urnes. «

 

Voter détruit tout sens de l'initiative, étouffe l'esprit de révolte individuelle, apprend aux gens à se reposer sur quelqu'un d'autre afin qu'il fasse pour eux ce qu'il devraient faire eux-même

 

» disait Voltairine de Cleyre. L'appel au vote est l'orchestration de cet étouffement. C'est l'appel au front uni avec la gauche et la relégation aux lendemains qui n'arrivent jamais des luttes les plus offensives contre l'État de gauche comme de droite.


On nous supplie de tout faire pour mettre la gauche au pouvoir mais on sait déjà ce que c'est. Toute gauche dite «

 

de rupture

 

» sera la gauche traditionnelle de demain. Le

PS

 contre le

PCF

, puis la

LFI

 contre le

PS

. La gauche mue au gré des vagues de mécontentement qu'elle parvient à récupérer avant de gérer la bonne perpétuation de l'État et du capital. Ce n'est donc pas particulièrement l'abstention qui entérine la reproduction du système électoral mais l'appel au vote qui le perpétue et le légitime. Car la gauche au pouvoir c'est : la légalisation des

CRA

, le tournant de la rigueur, la loi Travail, l'augmentation des expulsions de sans-papiers, l'allongement du temps de rétention, etc. Sauf que cette fois-ci, il y a en plus le populisme, le racisme, le patriotisme décomplexé, la défense de l'internationale réactionnaire de Poutine et le souverainisme de Mélenchon. Vous voulez vraiment tout faire pour en reprendre une louche

 

? Jouer le jeu de la chasse aux bulletins n'est pas une lubie passagère ou une précaution anodine mais une compromission dont l'enjeu est le braconnage de l'espoir.


Mais alors pourquoi et pour qui est-il si important que les franges radicales votent

 

? Nous commençons à voir venir une invasion d'appels aux votes par tous les pores des aires subversives, de notre voisin d'

AG

 «

 

anarchiste nihiliste

 

», au «

 

toto à fond dans la bataille culturelle

 

». Ils sont nombreux à nous expliquer qu'ils ne votent jamais, mais là... Et, si un communiste matérialiste, grand stratège de la théorie révolutionnaire, nous explique que la venue au pouvoir de la gauche permet le franchissement d'une première étape dans l'accomplissement d'objectifs révolutionnaires, et bien, on peut lui répondre : «

 

non, ta gueule

 

». Pourquoi tant de zèle

 

? Comment ne pas comprendre qu'une gauche qui se recompose pour prendre le pouvoir cherche, entre autre, à ce que sa recomposition nous digère aussi, évitant ainsi que le mythe frelaté du «

 

troisième tour social

 

» ne puisse à aucun moment se réaliser

 

? Depuis quelques jours, les lycéens s'organisent et dynamitent cette morne rentrée. Soyons solidaires, et emboîtons le pas

 

!


Contre toute démocratie, directe ou indirecte, contre toutes leurs formes de contrôle et de mise au travail,


contre le cynisme et contre la résignation, rendez-vous pour une

AG

 contre l'électoralisme et ses chantages.

Часть 1. Объяснение социального.

5.1. Описательное определение социального класса

Как мы видели ранее, когда устойчивая вероятность получения продолжительного повиновения ряду приказов со стороны другого или других институционализирована, мы имеем отношение господства. Эта институционализация есть базовый фундамент классовых отношений; следовательно, фундамент формирования социальных классов и самой классовой структуры, в которой они имеют место.

Обратимся же к этой центральной для нашего интереса теме.

Наша последовательность обязывает нас начать с описательного определения социального класса, чтобы затем попытаться дать его объяснение, допускающее эмпирическую проверку.

Начнём с начала. Явление, которое нас здесь занимает, – это социальная асимметрия, неравенство. Когда оно последовательно и устойчиво, то есть когда оно принимает структурный характер, тогда ищется описательное определение, которое составляет сущностное понятие этого явления, всегда воспринимавшегося и понимавшегося как неравенство, как асимметрия.

Самое главное и определяющее в социальном классе – если сформулировать это как можно более универсально – состоит вот в чём: люди, принадлежащие к одному классу, относительно равны между собой именно в том, что касается неравно распределённых в обществе благ и позиций. Или, говоря по-другому, социальные классы есть объединения людей, относительно однородными между собой, у членов этих объединений примерно одинаковый доступ – или одинаковое отсутствие доступа – к тому, что распределено в обществе неравно; объединения, сходные с точки зрения имеющихся атрибутов социального неравенства.

Понятое так, понятие класса относительно существованию других классов. Общество принимает структуру социальных классов в том, что касается распределения того, что в нём неравно. Разумеется, мы имеем в виду не исключительно блага и материальные ресурсы. Мы, конечно, ссылаемся и на них; и не только в количественном, но и в качественном отношении (не только сколько, но и какие виды благ; не только размер вознаграждения или дохода, но и на каком основании, за какой вид труда или услуги, когда речь идёт о зарплате; и так далее). Но круг этих элементов шире. Всё, что распределяется неравно: различный доступ или различная подверженность принуждению, политическая власть, социальный престиж и так далее (также здесь в количественном и качественном отношении).

Это постулат данного способа понимания классовой структуры: аспекты неравенства у членов одного класса совпадают. То есть всё, что в обществе распределяется неравно, распределяется так, что асимметрия стремится к совпадению. Есть привилегированные и обездоленные в отношении этих элементов в их совокупности. И, разумеется, могут быть – и есть – более или менее промежуточные, более или менее отличающиеся ситуации.

Другая коннотация классовой структуры – помимо множественности классов и совпадения асимметрий – состоит в том, что, как несущественны для этих целей неустойчивые неравенства[1], так же несущественны и ситуативные неравенства . Речь, следовательно, идёт о неравенствах последовательных, устойчивых, институционализированных, резистентных. Таким образом, что одни неравенства подкрепляют другие: они действительно структурны, как уже было сказано.

В заключение мы можем описательно определить конкретные социальные классы как те человеческие совокупности, которые участвуют в относительном сходстве или структурном равенстве – количественном и качественном – в отношении тех аспектов, элементов или атрибутов, что распределены неравно в обществе.

[1] В 50-е годы, начиная со статьи Ленски (Lenski, Gerhard: «Status Crystalization: A Non Vertical Dimension of Social Stratification» в American Sociological Review, август 1954), был поставлен …

author: Unknown
title: Ephéméride des luttes : 7 octobre
content:
Le 7 octobre, l'éphéméride des luttes doit se confronter à de nouvelles techniques d'exploitation et de commercialisation, tout en continuant à se battre contre les fascistes de toute sorte et l'énergie nucléaire, entre autres joyeusetés.


1800 :

 En Virginie en Amérique du Nord, Gabriel Prosser, qui avait été auparavant le leader d'une grande révolte d'esclaves, est exécuté.


1879 :

 A Gävle en Suède, naissance de Joe Hill, poète, chansonnier et militant anarcho-syndicaliste. Il sera fusillé le

15 novembre

 1915 aux Etats-Unis.


1905 :

 A Moscou, début de la grève générale d'octobre.


1913 :

 Aux USA, Henry Ford révolutionne l'industrie en introduisant le concept de la chaîne de montage, dépossédant encore un peu plus les travailleurs de leur savoir-faire et rendant le travail de plus en plus aliéné et aliénant.


1934 :

 A São Paulo, les ligues fascisantes de l'Action Intégraliste organisent une manifestation sur le modèle de la marche sur Rome mussolinienne. Une contre-manifestation appelée par les anarchistes l'attaque, tuant trois policiers et deux intégralistes.


1943 :

 A Auschwitz, plusieurs centaines de membres d'un Sonderkommando du crematorium IV attaquent les gardes SS au marteau, hache et pierre, ainsi qu'avec des grenades artisanales et détruisent le bâtiment. Réalisant l'attaque, les ouvriers du crematorium II jettent un garde au four et incendient l'immeuble avant d'attaquer les SS. Des trous sont perçés dans les grillages et plusieurs barraquements sont incendiés.


1944 :

 A Auschwitz, une révolte éclate dans le camp de concentration tristement célèbre : 250 prisonnières se soulèvent ensemble, mais elles seront toutes capturées et exécutées.


1952 :

 Le code-barres est breveté aux Etats-Unis : un pas en avant dans la numérisation et la commercialisation du monde et de tout ce qu'il contient.


1962 :

 A New York, 'La Mano Negra' fait sauter une bombe dans le domicile du cardinal Spellman, ami intime du dictateur Franco, pour dénoncer la collaboration de l'église catholique avec la dictature franquiste.


1977 :

 - A Madrid, les GRAPO (Groupes de résistance antifasciste du premier octobre) placent une bombe dans le métro, qui ne fait aucun blessé, ainsi qu'au siège du parti marxiste-léniniste 'Organisation révolutionnaire des travailleurs'.


 A Belfast, l'IRA abat Desmond Irvine, nationaliste et président de l'Association des Officiers de Prison d'Irlande du Nord.


1981 :

 A Toulouse, des explosifs sont placés contre un transformateur EDF contre l'énergie nucléaire, tandis que la lutte contre l'installation de la centrale nucléaire de Golfech dans la région se poursuit depuis plusieurs années.


1982 :

 En Irlande du Nord, L'Armée de Libération Nationale Irlandaise (INLA) abat une gardienne de prison et un officier de l'Ulster Defence Regiment.


1996 :

 A Lisburn en Irlande du Nord, l'IRA Provisoire fait sauter deux voitures piégées de forte puissance au Quartier Général de l'Armée Britannique, qui était considérée comme la base militaire la plus sécurisée du pays. L'explosion coïncide avec l'ouverture du Congrès du Parti Conservateur. Le groupe

revendique le lendemain

.


2001 :

 Le XXIème siècle s'ouvre vraiment avec le lancement de la "Guerre Globale contre le Terrorisme" suite aux attentats du World Trade Center.


2014 :

 A Bâle, une voiture de police est incendiée en solidarité avec les migrant-e-s, alors que l'Europe met en place une opération de chasse aux migrant-e-s d'une ampleur démesurée : l'opération Mos Maiorum.


2018 :

 A Nantes, une dizaine de véhicules d'Eiffage sont incendiés par les

Renard.e.s

 du fait de leur rôle dans la construction des prisons et de la société d'enfermement.


Voir également

l'éphéméride anarchiste

 du 7 octobre.

title: Эррико Малатеста - Учредительное собрание и Диктатура
content:

Превосходный коммунистическо-анархический двухнедельник Le Reveil – Il Risveglio, который вот уже двадцать четыре года публикует на итальянском и французском языках товарищ Луиджи Бертони в Швейцарии (Женева, улица Savoises, 6), переводит замечания, сделанные мною в №20 этого Журнала по поводу возможного Учредительного собрания, и добавляет к ним заметку, в которой обращает внимание «на вспомогательный вопрос, подсказанный самым болезненным опытом: Как воспрепятствовать тому, чтобы наша Оппозиция Учредительному собранию не открыла путь к диктатуре?».

Вопрос действительно важный и срочный, поскольку времена быстро зреют, – мы можем в любой момент оказаться перед ситуацией, которая больше не позволит нам дискутировать и обяжет нас к быстрым действиям, к которым мы должны быть уже умственно готовы. Поэтому я в свою очередь приглашаю товарищей тщательно разобрать аргумент со всех различных точек зрения, а пока даю здесь свой вклад в дискуссию.

Между Учредительным собранием и Диктатурой нет существенной разницы. И то, и другое – это власти, которые сосредоточивают, или пытаются сосредоточить, в своих руках все социальные силы, чтобы навязать обществу свои идеи и, прежде всего, свои интересы. Они в своих современных, более или менее революционных формах действуют от имени «суверенного народа» или от имени «сознательного и развитого пролетариата»; но в действительности это всегда маленькие меньшинства, которые душат любую свободную инициативу и навязывают «народу», или «пролетариату», то есть всем, и особенно трудящимся, господство касты, или партии, когда это не господство одного или нескольких человек.

Однако разница всё же есть: пусть только в степени и в способах воздействия – но пренебрегать этой разницей никак нельзя, ведь в жизни и в истории всё, в конечном счёте, сводится именно к степени и к способу.

Диктатура – это достигнутая цель. Это маленькая группа, которой удалось создать военный и бюрократический организм, она господствует посредством него, всегда готовая сокрушить грубой силой любую попытку сопротивления.

Учредительное собрание – это пока ещё борьба между партиями за завоевание превосходства, чтобы навязать де-факто, если не де-юре, свою собственную диктатуру.

Диктатура – это свинцовая крышка: это открытое, наглое подавление всякой свободы, против которого нет иного возможного сопротивления, кроме заговора и вооружённого восстания.

Учредительное собрание из-за противостояния и борьбы между партиями нуждается, до тех пор пока одна из партий не сумеет навязать себя, в обращении к согласию большинства, в учёте течений мнений, которые волнуются в народной массе, и оставляет поэтому открытыми некоторые щели для свободы.

Следовательно, если действительно не было бы иного выхода, кроме Диктатуры или Учредительного собрания, мы не могли бы предпочесть ничего, кроме Учредительного собрания. Я говорю, разумеется, об Учредительном собрании, которое собралось бы во время или после восстания против установленных властей; ибо Учредительное собрание, созванное в монархическом режиме для решения о реформе конституции, было бы комедией, которая могла бы интересовать только республиканцев... республиканцев Его Величества.

Но, к счастью, есть иной выход – наш, который есть прямое действие масс.

Мы должны делать, и побуждать массы делать, не дожидаясь, пока придут приказы от какой-либо власти и из какого-либо центра.

Прежде всего, пропагандировать и осуществлять всеобщее вооружение, вооружение всех. Хорошенько остерегаться ловушки закона, который запретил бы ношение оружия определённым классам или определённым партиям под предлогом разоружения контрреволюционеров. На этом пути разоружёнными в конце концов оказались бы мы и масса трудящихся, и вскоре дело дошло бы до создания …

author: Luis Feliz Leon
title: Film Review: A Portrait of How Workers Build a Strike
content:
“Who Moves America” is touring the U.S., with upcoming screenings across the West Coast, Northeast, and South. See when it’s coming to your town, or request a screening,

here

.


In the new documentary

“Who Moves America,”

 filmmaker Yael Bridge offers a window into the working-class culture of one of the country’s largest unions, the International Brotherhood of Teamsters, at United Parcel Service (UPS) in 2023.


It’s a rare and moving portrait of a massive, diverse group of workers building themselves into a fighting force, who then must wrestle with a different version of victory than they expected.


We watch as 340,000 Teamsters gear up for a potential strike against package giant United Parcel Service, the largest private-sector union contract in North America. Behind the wheel in brown trucks and along conveyor belts in warehouses, their working conditions are grueling and dangerous: at the time, two drivers had died in the past year from sweltering heat.


If they strike, their market leverage from moving 6 percent of the country’s gross domestic product means they can cripple the company’s profits and send shock waves across the economy.


The last time UPS Teamsters struck was in 1997; grainy home video and archival footage from that strike is interspersed throughout the documentary. The film’s contemporary subjects—from strike veterans to workers who weren’t even born yet—reference that walkoff as a touchstone in their lives, Teamsters history, and the American labor movement.


‘REPLACE YOU WITH A HAND TRUCK’


Spoiler alert: A 2023 strike isn’t called. Members all across the country are chomping at the bit to walk off the job, but after the union reaches a tentative agreement that even the most strike-ready militants acknowledge is a much stronger pact than previous ones, the members ratify the contract 5 to 1. (The five-year contract is set to expire on July 31, 2028.)


So the film is deprived of the sexy stuff of massive picket lines and physical confrontations with strikebreakers. A simpler narrative of heroic workers taking on greedy bosses gives way instead to a thornier one, as workers who were charged up to strike wrestle with what it means to win these gains without walking off the job.


From covering the campaign, I recall workers seething in anger from the pandemic-era abuses and risks they were exposed to and wanting to stick it to management. “I can still vividly remember getting my drivers together outside the building when the pandemic first started and the fear on their faces that somehow they could bring the virus to their children,” delivery driver Greg Kerwood, a steward in Somerville, Massachusetts, told

Labor Notes

 at the time.


“Part of what happened when people got out there with the practice pickets was they started to feel a sense of their own power,” Kerwood said. “The shackles were beginning to break. And they were starting to stand up and hold their shoulders straight and put their heads high and start to take some pride in their own self-respect in the workplace.”


That pent-up anger meant high expectations that a strike could temporarily rebalance workers’ relationships to their management tormentors. “This company hates you,” Teamsters Local 804 President Vinnie Perone says in the documentary. “If they could, they would replace you with a hand-truck.”


REAL ORGANIZING, ON SCREEN


Like the 2024 documentary “Union,” which chronicled the stunning organizing victory of Amazon workers at a fulfillment center on Staten Island in New York City  (producer Mars Verrone was involved in both films), “Who Moves America” shows what organizing looks like in practice in the buildup to a potential strike.


Teamsters President Sean O’Brien makes a number of appearances, deploying tough talk against UPS that gets under corporate investors’ and executives’ skins. He’s recorded at his stately desk at Teamsters headquarters in Washington, D.C., relating an anecdote of how a fellow union leader was surprised by the size of the UPS National Negotiating Committee, which was expanded by appointing rank-and-file members.


But the film spends the bulk of its time tracking not the moves at the union’s top but the ferment below. O’Brien is on screen less than the Teamsters discussing the contract and developing working-class leadership across locales, from a beach in Southern California to the streets of Louisville, Kentucky, and Brooklyn, New York.

author: Unknown
title: Kevin Carson - Juneteenth, and the Right-Wing Conception of “Freedom”
content:
Author

: Kevin Carson

Title

: Juneteenth, and the Right-Wing Conception of “Freedom”

Date

: November 18th, 2024

Source

: https://c4ss.org/content/59964


 Billy Binion (“

Juneteenth is a Celebration of Freedom

,”

Reason

, June 19) writes that, despite widespread right-wing aversion to Juneteenth as a holiday, the GOP “in some sense still fashions itself as the party of freedom.”


 Matt Yglesias is most famous these days for his almost daily garbage takes; but years ago, back when the Republican progression toward fascism had gone no further than the Tea Party stage, he aptly commented on the

incoherence

 of right-wing conceptions of freedom:


 I continue to be fascinated by the way in which the rhetoric of “freedom” is always so closely associated with authoritarian populist nationalist movements. Absolutely nothing in the imagery of the video or the policy agenda of the Republican Party is suggestive of freedom. It’s full of flags and grim-faced folks and bourgeois respectability and military jets flying in tight formation. It’s an ad from a conservative politician that’s about exactly what an ad from a conservative politician ought to be about — about preserving a way of life against Muslims, freeloaders, sexual deviants, and other threats.


 Whenever the white, right-wing, and Evangelical demographic talks about its “freedoms,” you can get a good sense of what they mean by “freedoms” by translating it into “white folkways.” Whatever substantive content “freedom” has for them is wrapped up in a haze of 90s CMT video imagery about little white frame churches, porch swings, pickups, checkered picnic table cloths, gingham, flags, guns, and Murca HOO-raw!


 And the “threats” to these “freedoms” — i.e. white folkways — all boil down in one way or another to anything that undermines their status as the American cultural default by allowing people who are unlike them to exist in public: e.g. the very sight of multiracial commercials or TV sitcoms, trans people on beer cans, people speaking Spanish or same-sex couples holding hands in public, or schools teaching the actual history of slavery and acknowledging the existence of LGBT people.


 In short, their idea of “freedom” has about the same substantive content as “Freiheit” in Nazi ideology. Remember when Sarah Palin talked about the “pro-America parts of America”? Just change “the people” to “Volk,” and we’re getting into some serious

deja vu

.


 This is true as well for much of the “libertarian” right. Witness, for example,

this tweet

 from the Libertarian Party of New Hampshire’s Twitter account: “Anyone who celebrates Juneteenth should be deported from America.” This is far from atypical for them. They subsequently

tweeted

: “Degenerates must be expelled in order to maintain a libertarian social order.”


 You might think “libertarian” is an odd self-designation for people who object to a holiday celebrating the end of slavery, and who call for physically removing “degenerates” from society. The Mises Caucus, which controls both the national and New Hampshire Libertarian Party organisations, has about as much to do with actual liberty as the crossed-hammer stormtroopers in “

Waiting for the Worms

” (a song which LPNH probably has on repeat — probably only a matter of time until they adopt “final solution to strengthen the strain” as an official motto). But it’s nothing new.


 There has long been an authoritarian strain on the “libertarian” right. This was true at least as long ago as 1969, when Walter Block enthusiastically defended “

voluntary slavery

” — along with the implied right of the slave owner to

beat, torture, and mutilate

 the person who “voluntarily” sold themselves into slavery — as a logical implication of self-ownership and freedom of contract.


 And this has become even more true in recent years, starting with the rise of the so-called “paleolibertarian” movement of Ron Paul and Lew Rockwell in the 90s. title: Dubious China ties of Sara, Manases
content:
The Chinese Embassy may protest to high heavens that the P150-million it “donated” to a foundation headed by Sara Zimmerman Duterte Carpio was meant to “help” build classrooms in Davao City, but the Chinese corporations in Hong Kong and Southern China will be hard put proving that they were just buying banana chips from Cale 88, which appears to a small enterprise with a work force that is not even a dozen but scored a huge windfall of P1.25-billion from 2022 to 2025. This cannot be consistent with a business that paid an annual income tax that is a tad higher than P10,000. Moreover, Manases Carpio mysteriously disappeared as a stockholder with 47% equity when Sara was investigated and impeached. It turned out that another company also owned by the Dutertes “bought” Carpio’s interest.


Surely, Cale 88 Foods could not have shipped boatloads of banana chips to China with the few workers that it had. Most likely, and this is assuming that Cale 88 Foods were a legitimate food manufacturer, the venture could have bought huge volumes of banana chips from other companies in Tagum, Panabo (where prison labor can be exploited to the hilt) and other areas still free from the ravages of *fusarium wilt, particularly Tropical Race 4, and sent them to China. Stranger still, Philippine bananas had to go through the eye of a needle to enter the China market. China now produces bananas after claiming for years that Philippine bananas harbor pests.


Even then, the documents showed that the total sales of Cale 88 were only P208-million but inward remittances were P319.33-million. Curiously, the revenues were not reflected in the Statement of Assets, Liabilities and Net Worth (SALN) of Sara and her husband from 2019 to 2025. They had no cash on hand and cash in banks despite the fact that their transactions from 2009 to 2013 amounted to P2.7 billion, or between 70% and 80% of the total P3.3 billion flagged for that period. Sara became a public official only on 2007 and got married to Carpio in the same year. From where did she accumulate such enormous wealth?


On this basis alone, one could surmise that the Duterte political warlord family amassed their huge stash since the 1980s, when Rodrigo Duterte entered politics and emerged as the warlord of Davao City. But why are state-owned companies buying banana chips from Carpio rather than the thousands of family enterprises engaged in the same business? This question was raised at the Senate and the logical justification was that the Chinese were also into some hanky-panky, “buying” access and “cooperation” with Sara and Carpio. Before Sara broke with her Team Unity partners in 2023, the Chinese Embassy was cocksure that she was a shoo-in for the presidency in 2028. Yet, political conditions in the Philippines defy categorization by Confucius or Sun Tzu, and the more they believed in the theory of Sara’s invincibility, the more the Chinese would invest in the Duterte dynasty.


Nevertheless, the Chinese, who invented the word patience, could not purchase wisdom, and they failed to understand the calculus of chaos that underpins botched ambitions and tactical alliances among members of the political class. The linear thinking exhibited by the Chinese mission and the coterie of pro-China propagandists is their own folly. No one would wish to be drawn, quartered and their remains stuck in some pikes to champion the Duterte dynasty’s interest. Neither would anyone suffer lingzhi to protect Sara, Manases, Pulong, Baste, Kitty and, of course, the patriarch now awaiting trial before the International Criminal Court (ICC) in The Hague.


Witnesses testified on Oct. 6, 2026 that Sara and her beloved husband have 30 active accounts in eight banks, surely an indication that they trust the banking system, and Sara also has joint accounts with her father Rodrigo, with P193.7-million flitting from one account to another as the crow flies in 2014. There were seven inter-account transfers on March 28, 2014, involved the Duterte father and daughter. The transfers, each bearing a separate reference number, totaled P193.7 million. The largest was P55.13 million, followed by P41.72 million, four P20-million transfers and P16.85 million. Anti-Money Laundering Council (AMLC) executive director Atty. Ronel Buenaventura said these were movements of funds from one account to another within the same bank and were treated separately because they had different reference numbers.

author: Dennis Ward
title: Mandy Gull-Masty’s balancing act as Indigenous Services minister
content:
Over the past year and a half, Mandy Gull-Masty says a lot of people have asked, “Why is it that you chose to become the Indian agent?”


In May 2025, Gull-Masty, the first ever woman to be elected as the grand chief of the Grand Council of the Crees (Eeyou Istchee), became the first ever Indigenous person to head up Indigenous Services Canada (ISC).


The minister says she wants to support the vision of First Nations and “give them the tools they need so that they can take the space of determining how they want services delivered and ultimately doing the work of delivering those services, themselves.”


Gull-Masty admits the job comes with “a lot of balancing, a lot of stress, a lot of moments of quiet thought and deep reflection” and that she is “trying to maintain who she is.”


Gull-Masty has a number of high profile issues on her plate, including the reintroduction of the

First Nations Clean Water Act.


Another controversial piece of legislation is Bill S-2.


The government of Prime Minister Mark Carney has been accused of stalling on ending

the second-generation cut-off.


Consultation on Bill S-2 wrapped up in July.


While many in leadership have called for Parliament to pass the legislation, Gull-Masty says she’s trying to reflection everyone’s voice.


“It is very clear that while yes, while there are some Nations that want to pursue a one-parent rule, the consultations also demonstrated that there are Nations out there that feel very strongly that they need to be the ones that determine the criteria for what it means to be a citizen of their Nation,” says Gull-Masty on the season premiere of Face to Face.


“I have the unique challenge as the minister to ensure that while I’m trying to create the pathway for those Nations that want to have a one parent rule, I’m also looking to create a pathway for those who don’t,” says Gull-Masty.


Reforming the First Nations child welfare system is also a huge challenge on the minister’s plate.


Indigenous Services Canada Minister Mandy Gull Masty at a news conference on Parliament Hill to announce that money from the federal government to First Nation communities in Ontario for their child welfare systems will start to flow on May 29. Photo: Alison Seymour/APTN.


Next February will mark the 20th anniversary of the original complaint filed with the Canadian Human Rights Commission by the First Nations Child and Family Caring Society and the Assembly of First Nations (AFN) alleging discrimination in the on reserve child welfare system.


A decade ago, the Canadian Human Rights Tribunal (CHRT) ruled First Nations children were being discriminated against.


The AFN and federal government previously agreed to a $47.8 billion dollar deal but that was rejected by a majority of chiefs at an assembly in 2024.


Chiefs in Ontario negotiated a separate, $8-billion deal with Ottawa, which was approved by the CHRT in March.


Since that time, there has been a lot of legal wrangling before the CHRT, some of it over the loss of another commissioner.


Gull-Masty says people need to understand that Canada is looking for clarification on rulings and not “looking to push back” on rulings.


The minister believes the previous approach of trying to find one path forward for all First Nations, such as the First Nations-led and designed

Loving Justice Plan

, may not be the way to go.


“I’m also trying to be respectful of those communities that want to have the opportunity to seek what was put forward in other plans that are presented by the Caring Society,” says Gull-Masty.


“There’s good work there, there’s a lot of research that has been done there. We have referenced it. But ultimately, I really think that the regionalized approach and creating space for Nations themselves to determine what it is they want to do to support their youngest, most vulnerable members is one that is having traction and is one where there is a lot of conversations moving forward and is one where I’m seeing decisions that are leading to support of regionalized agreements,” says Gull-Masty.


Another issue that has been at the forefront in recent months that Gull-Masty believes needs a more nuanced approach, is criminalizing residential school denialism.


Many First Nations leaders expressed their disappointment when the

Canadian Senate

 voted down an amendment in June that would have rendered residential school denialism a punishable crime.
